name: Ondo US Dollar Yield Token (USDY)
issuer: Ondo Finance (Ondo USDY LLC)

how_to_invest.method: Direct mint via Ondo portal after KYC (non-US, $100k+)
Buy on secondary markets: Curve (Ethereum), Orca (Solana), CEX listings — any size, no KYC with Ondo

regions.note: Admission at ANY tier (incl. secondary markets or accredited/QP paths); the kyc field says which tier.

risk_notes: Bearer-style note rather than a fund share: holders rely on Ondo USDY LLC's collateral structure and the Ankura trust; the Ondo-set APY (4.65% as of April 2026) exceeds prevailing T-bill yields, implying duration/deposit spread. The 40-50 day mint seasoning makes fresh primary tokens illiquid. DeFiLlama lumps USDY with OUSG under 'ondo-yield-assets' (~$2.5B combined).

Docs / eligibility details

name: Ethena sUSDe (staked USDe)

name: Ethena USDtb

promotions.name: IXS Deposit Bonus Program
promotions.mechanic: Fixed IXS-token bonus set at deposit, independent of vault performance; vests exactly 90 days after deposit; claim within 30 days of vesting or it expires; bonuses vest and pay Nov 28 - Dec 11 2026; processing pauses mid-Dec to Jan 5 (claim windows in that period resume after Jan 5). Early withdrawal forfeits the unvested bonus. The vault itself is permissionless; KYC applies only to the bonus claim (one bonus per verified identity, verified at redemption).
promotions.caveats: Bonus paid in IXS tokens, which carry their own price volatility; annualized rate is the fixed 90-day bonus expressed yearly and is separate from (not additive guidance on) the variable vault yield. One bonus per verified identity.
